purpose: English neutral retrieval evaluation for Thinker (SPEC/14 revision (v)): the 34 questions of neutral-eval.json translated faithfully into English, to choose the English retrieval configuration by the same candidates and the same declared selection rule before it is frozen.
needs: Each question has exactly the needs of the Finnish question with the same id (same view, same stable features: actor, event_type, content substring of the Finnish source record, newest-or-any). The needs name records, not words, so they are language-independent; they are read from the Finnish file at every run and never copied here.
translation: Faithful translations of the Finnish questions, written 5 Oct 2026 before any English retrieval was run and not tuned to it; the English UI's terms (lohko = sector, kaakkoisrintama = south-east front, syttymäkohta = point of origin); unit codes unchanged; revision (ae), 9 Oct 2026: the place names and VPK in their English form from app/i18n/place-names.ts, as the English records now name them (Lahdenkylä = Bay Village, Mökkiranta = Lakeside Cottages, Karhujärvi = Bear Lake), nothing else changed. DRAFT, for native and domain review.
exclusions: As the Finnish set: nothing about VPK's rekindle objection, the bog/Rahkasuo smoulder, the 20 kV line / F7 / power line, or the step-18 contradiction.
